title: Lightly Crisp Vietnamese Pork Knuckle Canh Chua
description: Fatty and crunchy, this festive Vietnamese dish is perfect for special occasions. Serve with steamed rice and fresh herbs.
instructions: Pat the pork knuckle dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, and dashi extract.
Rub the mixture all over the pork knuckle, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork knuckle to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the pork knuckle is baking, heat the garlic and ginger in the same skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and stir-fry until fragrant.
Once the pork knuckle is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the pork knuckle into thick slices and serve with the scallion-garlic sauce.
